channel.title: CB Marquee Characters updates
channel.description: Price, availability and guide updates from CB Marquee Characters, light-up letter and number rentals in Sydney and across Cape Breton, Nova Scotia.

item.title: Planning guide: how to plan light-up letters for an event in Cape Breton
item.description: Seven steps: count the characters, measure 2 feet per letter, find one regular outlet, pick a flat spot indoors or out, plan the photo, book the window of up to 4 days, confirm the quote. LOVE is $215 plus HST with Sydney-area delivery.

item.title: New prices for October 2026: from $45 per character for up to 4 days, $25 delivery in the Sydney area
item.description: Letters and numbers are $45 each plus HST for up to 4 days at one flat price. E, K, M, Q, S, V, X, 0 and 1 are $50 and the ampersand is $55. A 25% non-refundable deposit holds the date. Delivery, set-up and pick-up is $25 in the Sydney area and quoted for the rest of Cape Breton Island.

item.title: Site launched with FAQ, service area and Google reviews
item.description: The new cbmarqueecharacters.ca is live with photos from past events, a word preview tool, pricing, a seven-question FAQ and the Cape Breton communities we deliver to.
